title: Staff and readers use their existing site permissions through MCP
description:
Feature: Work through Papyrus MCP
Scenario: An editor directs a reference decision
  Given an editor is connected to the publication
  When their agent accepts a reference
  Then the recorded decision follows the publication permissions and attribution rules
Scenario: A reader submits a link
  Given a signed-in reader and enabled Reader Steering
  When their agent submits a link
  Then the link is submitted under that reader identity
  And the connection cannot read newsroom records
